title: AM Performance marketing
jobDescription:
Practo Company Profile Practo is the world's leading, and India's first profitable, integrated healthcare platform. Founded in 2008, its mission is to make quality healthcare accessible and affordable by connecting the entire ecosystem: patients, doctors, clinics, hospitals, pharmacies, and diagnostics. The platform is a singular destination that helps consumers with finding healthcare providers, booking appointments, online consultations, getting lab tests done at home, and ordering medicines. Practo also provides software like Practo Ray and Insta to help healthcare providers—from small clinics to large hospitals—digitize their operations for more efficient care. Practo has helped over 30 Cr+ patients with 1.2L+ verified doctor-partners in 22+ countries. The company maintains high data security standards, including 256-bit encryption, HIPAA-compliant data centers, and ISO 27001 certification.123456 Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Performance Marketing As a Senior Executive / Assistant Manager of Performance Marketing, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution and optimization of Practo’s paid acquisition campaigns. We are looking for a hands-on specialist who is an expert in Google’s search ecosystem and possesses the analytical rigor to diagnose performance trends and suggest immediate corrective actions. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
● Execution Excellence: Lead the end-to-end setup, monitoring, and optimization of performance campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, and other digital channels. ● Search & PMax Specialist: Own the performance of Keyword Search Ads (KSA) and Dynamic Search Ads (DSA). Drive cross-channel growth by managing and scaling Performance Max (PMax) campaigns. ● Data Analytics & RCA: Regularly perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on campaign data to identify performance gaps. You won't just report numbers; you will provide clear action recommendations to improve KPIs. ● Budget Tracking: Closely monitor daily spends and performance metrics to ensure budgets are utilized efficiently with minimal wastage. ● Funnel Optimization: Analyze the user journey from ad impression to conversion, identifying bottlenecks and recommending improvements for landing pages and lead quality. ● Cross-functional Support: Work closely with Design and Content teams to refresh ad creatives and with the Analytics team to ensure seamless tracking via GTM and GA4. ● Reporting: Create and maintain detailed performance dashboards that provide transparency into ROI and acquisition costs. Behavioral Traits: ● Detail-Oriented: A hawk-eye for campaign settings, tracking codes, and data discrepancies. ● Ownership: A proactive "get things done" attitude with a strong sense of accountability for meeting targets. ● Curiosity: A constant desire to experiment with new ad formats, bidding strategies, and automation tools. ● Resilience: Ability to maintain focus and deliver results in a high-pressure, rapidly changing environment. Required Skills and Experience: ● 3–5 years of experience in hands-on performance marketing, ideally in a fast-paced startup or digital agency. ● Technical Mastery: Deep experience with Google Ads (KSA, DSA, and PMax) and Meta Ads Manager is mandatory. ● Analytical Mindset: Strong proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Tag Manager. You should be comfortable "living in the data." ● Advanced Excel/Google Sheets: Expertise in using pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data visualization to perform deep-dive analytics and trend forecasting. ● Strategic Thinking: Proven ability to not only identify what happened in a campaign but why it happened and how to fix it. ● Tools: Familiarity with CRM tools (like Lead Squared or Hub Spot) to track lead-to-sale attribution is a plus.

title: Product Manager
jobDescription: 3–6 years of product management experience, with at least 2 years on a B2B Saa S or platform product involving technical integrations (APIs, webhooks, third-party systems). Strong prioritisation instincts — you can separate signal from noise, say no clearly, and build roadmaps that reflect real tradeoffs. Work closely with engineering, design, business, and external partners to define, scope, and ship integration-heavy features — from API contracts to UX flows. Translate partner requirements (SLAs, data needs, workflows) into clear, well-scoped product specs without losing sight of the end consumer experience. Define and track metrics that matter across both B2B (activation, integration health, partner retention) and B2C (engagement, conversion, satisfaction) surfaces. Partner with sales, customer success, and business teams to shape GTM strategy and support commercial conversations with technical credibility. Anticipate integration failure modes, edge cases, and system dependencies early — and build these into planning, not just post-launch firefighting.

title: Enterprise Sales Specialist
jobDescription: Build and own the enterprise sales motion for a brand-new API product — sold to insurers, TPAs, health-tech aggregators, and large enterprises who want to offer doctor appointment booking and teleconsultation on their own platforms. This is a true zero-to-one role. You won't inherit a deck and a price list — you'll help create them by being in front of partners, listening, and proposing. If you want a defined territory and a fixed quota, this is not your role. If you want to shape a category, it is. Generate pipeline. Find and open new partners across insurers, TPAs, aggregators, and enterprises. You build the top of the funnel; you don't wait for it. Close mid-sized deals end-to-end. Run these yourself — discovery, solution, commercials, contract. Quarterback large deals. Bring in senior leadership at the right moment and orchestrate the close. Consult, don't just sell. Advise partners on how to embed the API to grow their business — new member value, better engagement, OPD/benefit completion. The best deals here are solved problems, not pushed products. Own commercials. Negotiate and close pricing in a still-forming model — which means proposing structures, not quoting from a sheet. Grow the book. Retain and expand existing accounts. Land-and-expand is the game. Who we're looking for 5–9 years in enterprise/B2B sales or partnerships, ideally selling into insurers, TPAs, health benefits, health-tech, or API/Saa S to enterprise buyers. (Exceptional candidates with less experience but clear evidence of the traits below will be considered.) Entrepreneurial and comfortable with ambiguity. You create structure where there is none and are energised, not paralysed, by an unfinished product. Consultative and commercially sharp. You understand a partner's P&L well enough to make their case for them, and you can construct and defend a pricing conversation. A genuine closer. You move deals to signature and revenue, not just to "interested." Willing to travel intensely.

title: Senior SDET
jobDescription: Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks across web (responsive/desktop), mobile (Android & i OS), and API layers. Own end-to-end test coverage for assigned product areas — from test design and review to CI integration and release sign-off. Architect and improve framework patterns: Page Object Model, fragment/screen scoping for mobile, contract-driven API testing (Swagger/Open API), and robust locator strategies. Integrate AI into the testing lifecycle: AI-assisted test case generation, self-healing/auto-recovering locators, intelligent failure triage, and flakiness detection. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated regression and smoke suites; keep execution fast, parallel, and reliable. Triage production errors and quality signals (e.g., Sentry, New Relic), correlate them with test gaps, and drive coverage improvements. Define and report automation coverage and quality metrics (bug-miss rate, bug ratio, SLA adherence, coverage %). Mentor mid-level and junior SDETs through reviews, pairing, and framework guidance. Partner with dev EMs and product on testing scope for upcoming work and shift-left quality practices. 5+ years in test automation / SDET roles, with at least 2 years on complex, multi-layer automation (UI + API + mobile). Strong programming skills in Python (and/or Java/Java Script) — clean, maintainable, well-structured test code. Hands-on expertise with: UI automation — Selenium / Playwright / Robot Framework, with solid locator and POM design. Mobile automation — Appium for Android and i OS, including handling fragments, accessibility identifiers, and device/emulator variability. API automation — REST testing, contract testing via Swagger/Open API, stubs/mocks for self-contained suites. Experience designing automation frameworks from scratch, not just writing test cases against an existing one. Strong grasp of CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins/Git Hub Actions), version control (Git), and test reporting. Working knowledge of debugging across the stack — browser console/DOM inspection, mobile logs, network traces. Solid understanding of QA metrics, bug lifecycle, and release quality gates.

title: Senior Software Engineer
jobDescription: Senior Software Engineer Location: Bengaluru, India Department: Backend Engineering Employment Type: Full-Time, In Office The Mission: Scalability Meets Exploration At Practo, we are solving healthcare accessibility for over a billion people. To do this, we run a massive, high-throughput ecosystem of microservices that handle millions of highly sensitive, real-time medical interactions daily. We are at an exciting inflection point. While we continue to design, build, and scale our core backend systems to support major new product features, we are also actively exploring how to leverage autonomous AI agents to transform our workflows. We aren't looking for pure AI researchers or prompt engineers. We need a Systems Thinker—a Senior Backend Engineer who loves building greenfield features, designing clean microservice architectures, and handling high-scale distributed systems. Your job will be to ship new features and scale our core engines, while helping us experiment with and lay the resilient backend infrastructure needed for agentic workflows as they evolve. What You’ll Actually Do (The Real Work) Build, Scale & Evolve Core Services: You will spend your time designing and implementing brand-new, high-impact backend features and greenfield microservices from scratch, while also driving the architectural evolution of our core systems. You'll work across a tactical mix of PHP, Python, and Java, prioritizing system design, high concurrency, thread safety, and API design. Lay the Groundwork for Agentic Workflows: Help us explore and prototype the foundational backend layer for our upcoming AI initiatives. This means designing adaptable data schemas, building flexible orchestration pipelines, and helping us figure out how to cleanly integrate non-deterministic workflows into our stable, core production systems as our roadmap takes shape.
